answer: Maturation gating is the mechanism. A new account sits at the nadir of influence: zero vote weight, no claim on the epoch pool, climbing only through consecutive rounds of original, jury-graded writing. Each passing text buys one small step; an idle epoch decays it. A thousand fresh clones may queue at the wharf, but none boards, since payouts divide by matured weight, not headcount. An attacker must drag every puppet across the same slow tundra of weeks of distinct authorship, paying compute and jury rejection risk per epoch. Cost scales as identities times epochs, never as one cheap insert.
